facts.fact: The Miscellaneous Amendments Act 2023 (Act 22 of 2023, assented 8 November 2023) amends the National Identity Cards Act, Cap. 294, a statute in force, adding a card for non-resident citizens (new section 4A) and new rules on disclosing card information.

note: The Act states a card bears a National Identity Number but not that it is unique, biometric or electronically checkable, and no regulation under it is dated, so no cover fact.
